description: Description-trigger eval set: realistic user prompts labelled with whether the skill's description should activate. Positives probe the skill's scope (casual phrasing, unstated need, buried inside a larger ask); negatives are near-misses that share vocabulary but need a different skill, so they test precision, not just breadth. train guides edits to a description; validation is held out and only scores the result. Run `python3 evals/run_triggers.py --invoke '<cmd>'`; see skills/quality/SKILL.md.
